thread:
Marta (CS): Quick customer-facing mini-runbook for onboarding demos -> prod. Goals: avoid cold starts, keep predictable token spend, surface a renewal signal. Need eng + SE ack.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Short & sweet looks good. Recommend a 50-prefix warmup script and SDK examples. Telemetry: token_count, p95_latency_ms, cache_hit_rate, streaming_chunks, renewal_risk (boolean).

Jamal (Eng-SRE): Ops knobs: cache_ttl_sec=900 (15m) for onboarding orgs; prefill 50 prefixes; max_batch_latency_ms=25 for interactive routes; streaming_initial_chunk_tokens=64. Configure fallback_model (quantized) when queue_depth > 70%. Add watchdog to revert cache if error_rate > 2%.

Marta (CS): Customer runbook (copy for email/docs):
- Preflight: confirm API key, billing, chosen model & SLOs.
- Warmup: run warmup script (50 synthetic requests matching demo prompts).
- Cache: enable prefix cache with TTL=900s; expect cache_hit_rate >= 60% after warmup.
- Streaming: enable streaming for interactive flows, initial chunk 64 tokens.
- Batching: max_batch_latency_ms = 25; validate p95 latency.
- Fallbacks: set fallback_model to quantized variant; verify fallback telemetry.
- Feedback: single in-demo pulse: "Was this helpful? (yes/no)" + optional comment. Tag account renewal_risk=true on negative.

Marta (CS): Example curl for customers to include in docs:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/open-14b","prompt":"<demo prompt>","stream":true,"cache_prefix":"org-{{ORG_ID}}/demo","batch_window_ms":20}'
```

Priya (Solutions Eng): YAML route config snippet for docs:
```
route_config:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25
  cache_ttl_sec: 900
  streaming_initial_chunk_tokens: 64
  fallback_model: "redwood/open-14b-quant"
```

Jamal (Eng-SRE): Internal ops checklist for the handoff:
- Run warmup job against customer's pinned model.
- Confirm KV cache sizing & cache_hit_rate.
- Start a 10% canary streaming path for demo traffic.
- Monitor error_rate, token_cost, and latency for first 72h.
- If error_rate > 2% rollback streaming and open SRE ticket.

Marta (CS): Renewal signal flow:
- Capture in-demo pulse; follow up with NPS at day 7.
- If pulse = "no", set renewal_risk=true on account metadata.
- Auto-triage: if renewal_risk && token_spike > 30% -> schedule SE deep-dive + enablement.

Ethan (CSM): Owners: Marta -> enablement content & pulse copy; Priya -> SDK & warmup script; Jamal -> ops checklist + canary config. I'll create the kickoff invite.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for route "demo-interactive" started (canary=10%, image=redwood/open-14b@sha256:abc123).

Marta (CS): Plan: publish mini-runbook to onboarding docs and share with customer 1 hour before kickoff. Small steps.

Jamal (Eng-SRE): I'll push canary config by EOD and ping here when done.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll add the SDK examples & warmup script to docs repo and link back.

Marta (CS): Thanks — closing once customer confirms cache hits and the in-demo pulse works.
